## Activity

During February 2021, West Gate Eye Clinic completed 248 retinal image captures. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The activity recorded for the month reflects the work completed through the clinic’s scheduled sessions. No disruption to the overall session plan was reported, and routine leave was managed within normal operating arrangements.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 18 were assessed as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 7.3% of captures. The result should be monitored through routine quality review, with attention given to capture technique and any recurring factors that may affect image usability. The findings provide a basis for ongoing local review of image quality and support for staff involved in image acquisition.

## Grading

Grading identified 43 referable results. The median lag from photograph capture to grading was 1 day. This indicates that most images progressed through the grading process within a short interval. The clinic should continue to review grading activity alongside image quality and referral outcomes as part of its routine operational monitoring. Overall, the February 2021 activity shows continued service delivery, with image quality and grading performance documented for local oversight.
